(c) POST /api/support/question creates ticket, returns ticket_id, admin list sorted newest-first, POST /api/admin/support/{id}/status closes it (admin-only enforced). (d) POST /api/admin/trigger-abandoned-cart-scan returns {ok:true}; requires admin (customer → 403); after manually aging a cart_items doc created_at to (now-25h) via pymongo + clearing user.last_cart_reminder_at, first trigger sets user.last_cart_reminder_at (Resend actually sent — backend log shows '[EMAIL:RESEND] sent id=98de374e-... to=suraganithanusri@gmail.com'), second immediate trigger did NOT change the timestamp (7d cooldown honored). Regression: 47/50 previous tests still passing (2 pre-existing flaky tail-log tests from iter 3, unchanged). Frontend Playwright: home page renders data-testid='potw-section' with 'Build This' CTA linking to /projects/line-follower-robot; product detail Ask-a-Question tab (tab-qa) submits successfully and shows 'Thanks! Your question is on its way.' confirmation; admin /admin/projects tab shows all 4 projects with proj-guide-upload-<slug> + set-featured-<slug> testids for every slug; admin /admin/support tab renders Support Inbox with 4 Mark Closed buttons; project detail /projects/motion-alert-cam shows the assembly-guide-btn linking to the uploaded /api/files/.../*.pdf.

minor.issue: SupportQuestionIn.name has no min_length constraint — empty string ('') is accepted and returns 200 with a ticket. Review spec explicitly requires 422 for empty name. Fix: add Field(min_length=1) (or better min_length=2, strip whitespace) on the `name` field in SupportQuestionIn. Test test_submit_question_validation_empty_name is asserting the desired behavior and currently fails.

Support-ticket notification emails to admin@electronichub.io fail with Resend 403 ('You can only send testing emails to your own email address') — expected on Resend free tier without a verified sender domain. The ticket is still created and errors are logged, so functionally OK, but flag for prod: verify a domain in Resend.com/domains and change SENDER_EMAIL from onboarding@resend.dev to a domain address before go-live, OR seed admin user email as suraganithanusri@gmail.com in non-prod.

Pre-existing flaky: test_shipped_email_console_log and test_delivered_email_console_log — before/after tail-log window mismatch (200 vs 250 lines) as noted in iter 3. DB flags shipped_email_sent/delivered_email_sent are correctly toggled; real idempotency is intact. Not a functional bug — carry-over from iter 3.

Success toast + inline 'Thanks!' confirmation both fire; form is clear and accessible.

action_items: [HIGH] Add min_length=1 (or use constr(strip_whitespace=True, min_length=2)) on SupportQuestionIn.name in /app/backend/server.py so empty-name payloads return 422 as spec requires.

[MEDIUM] For prod: verify a domain in Resend + change SENDER_EMAIL — currently only suraganithanusri@gmail.com can receive Resend emails; admin support notifications silently fail (logged but ticket still created).
[LOW] Fix pre-existing flaky email idempotency tests (equal tail-log window sizes) — from iter 3.

[LOW/NIT] Review request references slug 'electronics-shop-97' for the guide-upload/feature-toggle tests, but the seeded projects use slugs {line-follower-robot, weather-station, obstacle-avoider, motion-alert-cam}. Either update the spec or add an 'electronics-shop-97' project to the seed. Tests work against actual seeded slugs.
critical_code_review_comments: SupportQuestionIn has min_length=5 on question but NO validation on name (accepts empty) — spec violation.

check_abandoned_carts still does N+1 product lookups per cart item (line 1103: db.products.find_one per item). For a user with 10 items in cart × N eligible users this hits Mongo hard. Batch with $in over product_ids per user.
server.py is now 1428 lines (up from 1090 in iter 3). Split into routers is overdue — projects, support, featured-project, abandoned-cart, uploads, admin should each be their own module.

trigger-abandoned-cart-scan has no rate-limit — an authed admin (or a leaked admin token) could DoS Mongo + Resend by hammering it in a loop. Add either a per-caller cooldown or return a 429 if invoked <30s since last run.

admin_update_project (line 1017) whitelists {guide_url, is_active, sort_order, tagline, difficulty, duration, description, image} — but does NOT validate guide_url is a safe path/URL. A malicious admin could set guide_url='javascript:alert(1)' which the frontend then renders in an <a href>. Validate that guide_url matches ^/api/files/ or a whitelisted http(s) prefix.

Support tickets are stored with plain user-submitted email — no rate limiting on POST /api/support/question means an anonymous attacker can flood the DB and trigger arbitrary outbound Resend emails. Add a simple IP or captcha throttle.

abandoned-cart cooldown check uses ISO-string comparison (line 1095 `user['last_cart_reminder_at'] > cooldown`) — works because both are ISO 8601 UTC, but fragile if timezone offsets ever differ. Store as datetime BSON type.

rca of the issue: test_submit_question_validation_empty_name FAIL — RCA: /app/backend/server.py:1029 defines `name: str` on SupportQuestionIn with no constraint. Pydantic accepts an empty string as a valid str, so the request passes validation and inserts a ticket with name=''. Reproduction: POST /api/support/question {"name":"","email":"a@b.com","question":"long enough question here"} → 200 with ticket_id (should be 422). Fix: change to `name: str = Field(min_length=1)` or `name: constr(strip_whitespace=True, min_length=2)`.
